subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following analogy. 

YLP : KOB :: BUS : HFY :: RAN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

YLP : KOB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa755c04c3daf1c05155afbc195ebf714f85049a4abe7e900b116b75e4a3993.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e84d6cae4326fa831406df70380732117d2bb62a6ca3635bbab17e2b19edbdc4.png] 

BUS : HFY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0aa0eb14c45b634da6d76aab7e1be814074b44653a29d56b3ded51b144439b4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37fc081b5520eccb3a44d85bc757f252b04feba3de85003426a535426e7b1412.png] 

Similarly, RAN : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca99d801406148e875e6ddc7f7feec362875b11f6c2b4155bed0c3de878ac82.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f29be3fa1e982de9f63d063d5035dd57e008535ec55cee11aae8668f19c1828.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MZI".**
